title: VoiceTyper C++ native ASR dependency manifest
purpose: Machine-readable pin, license, ABI and artifact contract for the native ASR dependencies of the C++/Qt port. cmake/NativeAsr.cmake reads this file, so the build cannot silently drift from the documented pin. tests/contract/native_dependency_contract.cpp re-checks it at ctest time.

telemetry.statement: No VoiceTyper native ASR component opens a network connection, sends telemetry, analytics or crash reports, or downloads anything while recognizing. Both engines are local CPU inference: whisper.cpp is compiled into the binary as a static library, and parakeet.cpp is a locally shipped DLL reached through LoadLibraryW. Model files are only ever fetched by the explicit in-app model store (Phase C task t_dde60b29a779), never by the engine, the loader or any CTest.
telemetry.verification: PRIV-01 in docs/migration/cpp/parity-ledger.md; the CTest suite never downloads a model.

dependencies.abiNote: whisper.cpp has no C ABI version. The pin is the contract: FetchContent re-verifies the fetched HEAD against pinnedCommit and fails configure on mismatch.

integration.fetch: FetchContent URL (GitHub commit archive) + URL_HASH SHA256; content-addressed pin, no git required on the build machine

archive.fetchMethodRationale: GIT_SHALLOW is documented by CMake as incompatible with a commit hash as GIT_TAG ('works only with branch names and tags'), and a full 48 MB history clone is 2m34s on the Arch/WSL side and much slower on NTFS. The commit archive is 9.5 MB, its URL embeds the commit, and URL_HASH pins the bytes exactly, so the build is content-addressed and needs no git on PATH.

offlineEscapeHatch.effect: FetchContent uses this pre-fetched tree instead of downloading.
offlineEscapeHatch.verification: unchanged - the contentPins above are still re-hashed against the supplied tree, so it is accepted only when it is byte-identical to the pinned commit
offlineEscapeHatch.whyItExists: a Windows curl without a usable CA store cannot verify github.com (libcurl code 60), and air-gapped CI runners have no network at all

windowsApiLevel.value: _WIN32_WINNT=0x0601 for the vendored ggml/whisper targets only
windowsApiLevel.reason: MinGW-w64 13.1 does not ship THREAD_POWER_THROTTLING_STATE, which ggml-cpu.c uses inside '#if _WIN32_WINNT >= 0x0602'; the MinGW13 default of 0xa00 therefore fails to compile the pinned whisper.cpp. The type is absent from mingw1310_64's headers and present in the newer WinLibs headers, so this is a MinGW13 gap, not a VoiceTyper one.
windowsApiLevel.consequence: only ggml's 'ask Windows not to throttle this thread' optimisation is skipped; possible throughput difference on Windows 11 with more than four threads, no correctness change
windowsApiLevel.rejectedAlternative: compiling the ASR archive with a different GCC than the application would mix libstdc++ ABIs

contentPins.comment: SHA-256 of files inside the archive, taken from an independent `git fetch --depth 1 origin d09f61a708f3487afa956ff578e60eae5e7a233c` checkout of the same commit. cmake/NativeAsr.cmake re-hashes them after extraction, so the archive is proven to be that commit's tree and not a re-cut tag.

optionsNotPresentAtPin.GGML_WASM: not an option at d09f61a7; the WASM backend is only added under EMSCRIPTEN, which VoiceTyper never enables
optionsNotPresentAtPin.GGML_SPEECHD: no speech-dispatcher target exists anywhere in the tree at d09f61a7 (the last espeak/speechd integration was removed upstream long before this pin)
optionsNotPresentAtPin.WHISPER_BUILD_TOOLS: not an option at d09f61a7; every command-line tool of that era lives under examples/, which is switched off by WHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
optionsNotPresentAtPin.parakeet target: src/CMakeLists.txt at d09f61a7 also declares an unconditional C++ target named parakeet (include/parakeet.h, no ABI versioning). VoiceTyper must never bind it: the supported Parakeet surface is the shipped parakeet.dll C API below.

artifacts.name: libwhisper (static)
artifacts.producedBy: FetchContent sub-build of the pinned checkout
artifacts.note: No prebuilt whisper.cpp binary is shipped or downloaded; the sources are compiled from the pinned commit on every native build.

dependencies.toolchain: gcc.exe (MinGW-W64 x86_64-ucrt-mcf-seh, Brecht Sanders r1) 16.1.0, cmake 4.3.2, PARAKEET_SHARED=ON, GGML_NATIVE=OFF, GGML_LLAMAFILE=ON, GGML_OPENMP=OFF, CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS=-static -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++

integration.loader: LoadLibraryW / GetProcAddress (Win32) — no link-time dependency, no import library
integration.symbolPolicy: Only the six symbols above are resolved. A missing or differently-ABI'd library is an explicit error (engine_unavailable / abi_mismatch), never a silent Whisper fallback. The context handle is an opaque void*: no parakeet_capi type crosses into portable code.
integration.assertion: parakeet_capi_abi_version() must equal 6; any other value fails the open with EngineAvailabilityReason::abi_mismatch.

dependencies.license: see VoiceTyper repository LICENSE and installer notices; no upstream build record is bundled in the repository
dependencies.abiNote: No C header for mc_wasapi is present in the repository; its C ABI is the deliverable of Phase D task t_bec8c2127352 and must be recovered or reimplemented before it is bound. Recorded here so the artifact is pinned and hash-checked, not to imply an existing contract.

integration.loader: planned LoadLibraryW / GetProcAddress, same seam as parakeet_runtime

dependencies.abiNote: transcribe.cpp has no numeric ABI constant below 1.0. The binding asserts the exact library version (transcribe_version() == 0.3.1) AND re-checks the public struct sizes the binding passes across the ABI (transcribe_abi_struct_size() for model_load_params, session_params, run_params, capabilities) against the vendored header; a mismatch is an error, never a fallback.
dependencies.toolchain: MinGW-W64 x86_64-ucrt-posix-seh (Brecht Sanders r1) 13.1.0 from the Qt toolchain (C:\Users\Kvintilyanov\tools\Qt\Tools\Tools\mingw1310_64) with cmake/ninja from WinLibs; TRANSCRIBE_BUILD_SHARED=ON, TRANSCRIBE_VULKAN=OFF, TRANSCRIBE_GGML_BACKEND_DL=OFF, TRANSCRIBE_USE_SYSTEM_BLAS=OFF, -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0601. The MinGW generation MUST match the application: a GCC 16 build dies with 0xC0000139 / error 127 in-process (measured 2026-10-07).

integration.loader: LoadLibraryExW(LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DLL_LOAD_DIR | LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32) / GetProcAddress — no link-time dependency, no import library; the module is kept for the process lifetime because ggml installs a global terminate handler at load time and reloading after a FreeLibrary aborts the process
integration.symbolPolicy: Only the fourteen symbols above are resolved. A missing or differently-versioned library is an explicit error (engine_unavailable / unsupported), never a silent substitution of another engine.
integration.assertion: transcribe_version() must equal 0.3.1 and the four struct sizes must match the vendored header (native/transcribe/transcribe.h, sha256 d3617a0638387157af4f99596322d4c6bade2463aae88e0e76506fcd2130a082).
integration.modelWindow: transcribe_capabilities::max_audio_ms is read at load time (25.0 s for GigaAM-v3) and used to cut a longer dictation at a pause instead of degrading silently.

models.note: Model bytes are a user-visible, separately licensed artifact. Tests and the engine layer never download a model; they only check that a path exists and that the engine reports model_not_ready / corrupt_data for a missing or wrong file.

files.license: model card of the upstream repository (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
